title: FancyZones: "Move newly created windows to the current active monitor" re-shows a window the owning app has already hidden

judgment.rationale: Reproduce event timing around asynchronous placement and the second SetWindowPlacement call. The reported visibility race remains credible, but the existing guard is counterevidence to a simplistic fix.
evidence: The report supplies a small AllocConsole/SW_HIDE harness, window-event order and option/exclusion/single-monitor controls.
The latest author reply confirms reproduction after upgrading.
Current SizeWindowToRect already checks IsWindowVisible and chooses SW_HIDE for an invisible window; a simple missing visibility check is therefore not an accurate diagnosis.
Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesLib/FancyZonesWindowProcessing.cpp: DefineWindowType rejects non-visible windows.

Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesLib/WindowUtils.cpp: SizeWindowToRect snapshots visibility, may choose SW_RESTORE, sets WPF_ASYNCWINDOWPLACEMENT and calls SetWindowPlacement twice.
The public harness is https://github.com/Kjm520/google-drive-fs-terminal-bug/tree/main/for-powertoys; Google Drive is not required.

fix_assessment.rationale: Conditional lightweight proposal, not an implementation-grade design. The source already checks visibility; the asynchronous/repeated placement timing, rather than a missing guard, needs confirmation.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve visibility across deferred automatic relocation
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Visibility can change after the existing check but before asynchronous placement applies a previously selected show command.
plan: Confirm the show/hide/placement race with the supplied harness.
If confirmed, make automatic relocation preserve current visibility without replaying stale show semantics; keep intentional manual snapping separate.
Add a delayed-hide regression and normal visible/maximized-window controls.
verification: The harness remains hidden in all relocation timings.
Visible and maximized windows still relocate correctly across DPI boundaries.

confidence.rationale: The source already checks visibility; the asynchronous/repeated placement timing, rather than a missing guard, needs confirmation.

reproduce.title: Validate FancyZones automatic relocation report
reproduce.version_requirement: Current stable release; compare the reported version only in an isolated test environment if needed.
prerequisites: Use a disposable test account or controlled test machine; preserve existing user data.
steps: Build/run the linked small harness after reviewing it, on two monitors with the cursor on the secondary.
Compare option on/off, exclusion, single-monitor and delayed-hide controls.
Record visibility at classification, placement construction and both asynchronous placement applications.
reproduce.expected_result: Automatic relocation never undoes an owning application's hide; the precise timing boundary is captured.
